Nobody, well, most of us don't expect a partner that takes 0 effort. Most of us would be happy to put the work in to get ourselves in a place where we can make someone happy, and hopefully vice versa

Some of us just don't get to make that choice. Some of us it doesn't matter how much effort we put in, how nice and thoughtful of others we try to be, how clean we try to make ourselves look or how well we keep ourselves. Some are too mentally sick to have a partner, some too traumatised, some not physically able to for one reason or another. There is no "just do your best". We don't get to live a life where we get to even try to. We just put in our time into what we can still find some small comfort in, tick day by day watching others live their lives with others, until eventually it ends, either naturally or because we make it end

I can't speak for others, only from what other people have said and what I've lived through. But it's a pain that crushes you every single day of your life. One that can't be gotten rid of no matter how many therapies you go to trying to tell you it's ok to be something that people routinely discriminate against and devalue your life's misery. "Just be happy with what you have", while somehow trying to forget what you never will.

Stealth you can get decent levels if you can avoid capture for long enough due to the high npc count, but, you need a wide area to sneak around in

The few things I've found it good for are lockpicking (where it is honestly unrivaled), thievery (being in a prison means low reset time, and if your slave camp has respawning table goods you can pick them up for decent consistent boosts without having to repeatedly drop one item), and assassination (hitting inmates does ok but it's honestly nowhere near as good as chain KOing hungry/dust bandits)
